description: This file defines the LogView class, which is a custom Android TextView that implements the LogNode interface. It formats log messages, converts log priority integers to strings, handles exceptions, and displays log data within the view, optionally chaining to another LogNode.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays log messages received via the LogNode interface, with formatting and chaining capabilities.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and displays a log message; converts priority to string, handles exceptions, and updates the UI thread.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append strings with delimiters if they are not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Outputs a string as a new line in the LogView.
